answer: Seed the queue with honeypot tasks whose correct answer the graders already know. An identity that accepts one and answers wrong is flagged and loses standing, and three unrelated confirmations are needed before any score lands. Take 20 honeypots per 1,000 tasks, enough to catch a farm that answers by template inside one epoch. The river of cloned answers carries an ember it cannot see, because the task looks ordinary, and the prism of a shared template splits into identical wrong answers that the graders already hold.
